funnel.site.posthog: Site visits and contact intents are counted in PostHog.
funnel.site.mapsPending: Google Maps impressions and actions will appear once Google Business Profile is connected.
funnel.leads.title: By lead · panel
funnel.empty.body: Pick a longer period or another brand.
leads.title: Leads
leads.empty.filtered: Nothing matches these filters. Reset them, or log a call that came in.
leads.empty.none: Leads from the sites and calls you log appear here.
card.title: Lead
card.name: Name
card.noPii: Nothing the customer left is visible to you.
call.question: How did the call end?
payment.title: Payment
payment.invalid: Enter amounts like 95 or 95.50; the commission cannot exceed the bill.
create.title: Incoming call or message
create.description: A call or a message that bypassed the form becomes a lead.
places.title: Locations
places.window: Leads of the last {days} days. A share is a percent from {min} leads on; below that, “n of m”.
places.empty: No leads in the last 30 days
places.empty.body: A location appears here with its first lead.
experiments.title: Experiments
experiments.how: What each landing declared in code and the split it runs now. Results are in PostHog: each experiment links to its funnel.
experiments.empty.body: An experiment appears once a landing declares it at start. Pick another brand.
experiments.posthog.label: Open {key} in PostHog
experiments.enabled.label: {key} on
experiments.enabled.off: {key} is off: every visitor sees the control
experiments.edit.label: Change the split of {key}
experiments.edit.title: {key} · {brand}
experiments.edit.body: The variants come from the landing's code; here only their weights and the holdout change.
experiments.edit.weights.hint: Relative: 1 and 1 is half each, 3 and 1 is 75 % and 25 %. 0 takes a variant out.
experiments.edit.weights.invalid: Each weight is a number, 0 or more, and at least one is above 0.
experiments.edit.holdout.hint: Visitors kept out of the experiment, seeing the control. Empty for none.
experiments.edit.weightsWarning.title: The comparison starts again
experiments.edit.weightsWarning.body: Once the split changes, read the comparison in PostHog from the change on: before it the variants shared the traffic differently.
experiments.reset.title: {key}: back to the code?
experiments.reset.body: The switch, the weights and the holdout go back to what the landing declares.
placeSettings.description: What the site shows for this point. An empty field keeps the site's own value.
placeSettings.phone.hint: International format, e.g. +33612345678. Empty: the site's own number.
placeSettings.hours.empty: No hours here: the site uses its own.
placeSettings.area.empty: No communes here: the site uses its own area.
placeSettings.saved: Saved. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.conflict.title: Changed by someone else
placeSettings.conflict.body: Someone saved this place after you opened it. Reload to see their version; your edits here will be lost.
placeSettings.invalid: The server refused some fields; see the reasons below.
placeSettings.readOnly: Only an admin can change site data.
placeSettings.never: Never set from the panel: the site shows its own data.
placeSettings.kept: Kept as they are (not edited here): {fields}
placeSettings.withdrawn.body: Withdrawn: the site answers 404 for this point.
placeSettings.preview.title: What the site shows now
placeSettings.preview.open: Open now ({time} local): the call comes first.
placeSettings.preview.closed: Closed now ({time} local): the callback form and the messengers come first.
placeSettings.preview.unknown: The hours are the site's own, which the panel does not see, so it cannot tell whether the point is open now. Shown in the open-hours order.
placeSettings.preview.siteOwn: the site's own number, if it has one
placeSettings.history.empty: No changes from the panel yet.
placeSettings.history.revert.title: Revert this change?
placeSettings.history.revert.body: What was there before it becomes current again; the revert is itself recorded as a change. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.history.reverted: Reverted. Live on the site within ~10 min.
placeSettings.withdraw.title: Withdraw {slug}?
placeSettings.withdraw.body: Within ~10 min the site answers 404 for this point: its page and contacts disappear for visitors. The data and history stay; restoring brings the page back.
placeSettings.withdraw.done: Withdrawn. The site answers 404 for this point within ~10 min.
placeSettings.restore.title: Restore {slug}?
placeSettings.restore.body: Within ~10 min the site serves this point's page again.
placeSettings.restore.done: Restored. Back on the site within ~10 min.
addPlace.title: Add a place by hand
addPlace.description: For a point no lead or visit has named yet. Brand and slug as the site's config has them.
addPlace.slug.hint: Lowercase letters, digits, - and _, as in the site's address.
addPlace.exists: {brand} · {slug} is registered already: open its card instead.
live.status.live.hint: Changes by others appear here as they happen.
live.status.reconnecting.hint: The live connection dropped; the panel is getting it back. What is on screen may be a little behind.
live.status.offline.hint: No live connection: the panel re-reads the screen every minute instead.
placeSettings.stale.title: Saved by someone else meanwhile
placeSettings.stale.body: {by} saved this place at {at}. Your edits are still here, but saving them would overwrite that change, so it is refused — load the fresh data to go on.
pricing.title: Pricing
pricing.noBrands.body: A brand appears here once the panel knows its site.
pricing.status.title: Current pricing
pricing.status.none: The panel holds no model for this brand: its sites price from their built-in prices.
pricing.clear.title: Take {brand}'s pricing off?
pricing.clear.body: The sites will go back to their built-in prices. The history keeps this model; it can be pasted back in.
pricing.clear.done: Pricing taken off: the sites use their built-in prices
pricing.clear.conflict: Someone changed the pricing first. Look at it again before taking it off.
pricing.general.title: Whole model
pricing.hint.roundTo: Half up to a multiple of this: 1 rounds to the euro, 0.01 to the cent.
pricing.hint.minimum: An estimate never comes out lower. A fixed price is not raised.
pricing.inputs.title: Questions
pricing.inputs.body: What the visitor answers. Adds apply first, then multipliers, then discounts.
pricing.hint.slug: Lowercase latin letters, digits, - and _; up to 40.
pricing.field.label: Label ({locale})
pricing.options.title: Answers
pricing.hint.effect.discount: 0 is none, 15 is 15 % off; up to 100.
pricing.needs.title: Needs
pricing.needs.body: Priced by the site's subject id. A need not listed asks for a quote.
pricing.needs.empty: No needs priced yet: every form asks for a quote
pricing.hint.need: The subject id the site's form sends.
pricing.need.fixedNote: Shown as it is: neither rounded nor raised to the minimum.
pricing.need.askedNone: None: the estimate is the base.
pricing.saved: Pricing saved: the sites price from it now
pricing.conflict.title: Someone saved the pricing before you
pricing.conflict.body: Saved {at} by {by}. Your draft is kept.
pricing.conflict.bodyCleared: Taken off {at} by {by}. Your draft is kept.
pricing.conflict.unknown: Your draft is kept. Load the fresh pricing to see what changed.
pricing.fresher.title: The pricing changed while you edit
pricing.fresher.body: Saved {at} by {by}. Your draft is kept; saving it will ask first.
pricing.fresher.bodyCleared: Taken off {at} by {by}. Your draft is kept; saving it will ask first.
pricing.preview.title: Calculate
pricing.preview.body: This is how the site will price it: the server computes it.
pricing.preview.noneBody: The site would ask for a quote for this combination.
pricing.preview.invalid: The server refused the model at {path}: {message}
pricing.preview.noModel: The draft does not make a model yet.
pricing.preview.noNeeds: Add a need to calculate a price.
pricing.json.title: JSON
pricing.json.body: To bring a site's built-in model in, or take this one out.
pricing.json.copied: The model's JSON is on the clipboard
pricing.json.copyBlocked: Copying needs a draft that makes a model.
pricing.json.pasteBody: It replaces the draft; nothing is saved until you save.
pricing.json.hint: The same object the site's pricing model is: format, currency, validFrom, …
pricing.json.loaded: Loaded into the draft — not saved yet
pricing.history.title: History of changes
pricing.readonly.noneBody: The sites price from their built-in prices. An admin can bring a model in.
pricing.summary.general: Estimates are rounded to {round} and never below {minimum}.
pricing.problem.money: An amount in euros, at most two decimals: 45 or 45.50.
pricing.problem.percent: A percent, at most two decimals: 110 or 12.5.
pricing.problem.unknownField: A field the model does not have.
pricing.problem.slug: Lowercase latin letters, digits, - and _; 1 to 40.
pricing.problem.locale: Not a language code (fr, en, fr-FR).
pricing.problem.label: A label of 1 to {max} characters.
pricing.problem.dearest: The dearest combination passes the cap of 1 000 000 €.
pricing.problem.labelMissing: A label in {locale} is needed: the site shows it.
booking.match.contact.hint: Joined by the phone or email, not by the site's reference: make sure it is this customer.
booking.match.contact: By contact: a likely match, check it
booking.card.none: No booking yet. Set a time once it is agreed with the customer.
booking.conflict: The booking changed meanwhile, here or at the provider. The card now shows it as it stands.
slot.title: Set the time
slot.description: In your time zone, {zone}. The end is optional.
slot.problem.start: The start is a time, HH:MM.
slot.problem.end: The end is a time, HH:MM, or empty.
slot.problem.order: The end comes after the start.
unmatched.title: Bookings without a lead
unmatched.description: Booked at a provider, but no lead was found for them. Attach each one to its lead.
attach.title: Attach the booking
attach.description: {when} · {brand}. Pick its lead, or type the lead's id.
attach.search: Name, phone, request or lead id
attach.empty: No lead matches. Type its full id to attach it anyway.
attach.conflict: This booking was attached by hand already. The list is up to date now.
placeSettings.booking.manualHint: Manual has no page: the site promises a call and an operator records the time. It is always offered.
placeSettings.booking.pagesHint: Leave a page empty to not offer it. The default must be manual or a provider with a page.
placeSettings.problem.unknown_field: A field the site does not read.
placeSettings.problem.type: Not the expected kind of value.
placeSettings.problem.control: No line breaks or control characters.
placeSettings.problem.telegram_bot: 5–32 characters: Latin letters, digits and _, starting with a letter and ending in bot.
placeSettings.problem.messenger_unknown: Not a messenger the site knows.
placeSettings.problem.shape: Not in the shape the site reads.
placeSettings.problem.day: Not a day of the week.
placeSettings.problem.closes_before_open: Closes before it opens: split a night across midnight into two rows.
placeSettings.problem.postal_code: A French postal code: five digits.
placeSettings.problem.coordinate: Not a coordinate on the globe.
placeSettings.problem.review_url: A Google review link (g.page or search.google.com).
placeSettings.problem.unknown_key: The booking setting has a field the site does not read.
placeSettings.problem.provider_unknown: Not a provider the site knows.
placeSettings.problem.provider_shape: A provider's setting is its page.
placeSettings.problem.provider_extra: A provider takes its page only.
placeSettings.problem.manual: Manual is always offered: it takes no page.
placeSettings.problem.default_unknown: Not a provider the site knows.
placeSettings.problem.default_unset: Give this provider a page, or choose another default.
placeSettings.problem.default_choose: Choose what is offered by default to save the pages.
placeSettings.problem.format: An https:// address of at most 2048 characters, no spaces or accents.
placeSettings.problem.fragment: No # part: the site adds its own parameters.
placeSettings.problem.userinfo: No user or password before the host.
placeSettings.problem.ip: The host is a name, not an IP address.
placeSettings.problem.host: The host is not a domain name.
placeSettings.problem.google: A Google appointment schedule: https://calendar.app.google/… or https://calendar.google.com/calendar/appointments/…
placeSettings.problem.cal_host: A Cal.com page on cal.evinvest.ltd or cal.com.
placeSettings.problem.cal_path: A Cal.com page is /<user>/<event>, nothing more.
filter.ref.invalid: Not a ref: two to four letters, a dash, four to eight letters or digits (AQ-7K3F).
messenger.ref.copyFailed: Could not copy: select the reference by hand
messenger.awaiting: Awaiting the customer's message — match it by the reference
placeSettings.telegram.hint: The bot's username, without the @. Empty: no Telegram button.
placeSettings.messengers.hint: Off takes it out of the lead form: the form falls back to the phone. Other WhatsApp buttons on the site stay.
invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.description: USDT invoices in the Service-Arb scope. The payer pays on evinvest.ltd; the state comes from banking.
invoices.empty.body: An invoice you create appears here with its state.
invoices.create.title: New invoice
invoices.amount.hint: Like 12.5: up to 9 digits before the point and 6 after.
invoices.amount.invalid: Enter an amount above zero: up to 9 digits before the point and 6 after.
invoices.memo.hint: Optional, one line, up to {n} characters.
invoices.memo.tooLong: The memo is longer than {n} characters.
invoices.memo.control: The memo must be one line of plain text.
invoices.processing.hint: Payment received; waiting for the ledger to post it.
invoices.unavailable: Banking cannot issue invoices right now. Try again later.
invoices.conflict.invoice_not_open: Banking says this invoice is not open.
invoices.conflict.invoice_processing: A payment for this invoice is already in progress.
invoices.conflict.scope_frozen: The Service-Arb scope is frozen at banking. No invoices can be issued.
invoices.conflict.idempotency_conflict: This request was already sent with other terms. Check the list and try again.
invoices.pay.sent: Payment sent. The state changes when banking confirms it.
invoices.pay.failed: The payment did not go through.
invoices.pay.timeout: The payment window timed out. The state below is what banking says now.
invoices.pay.invalid: This invoice cannot be paid from here.
invoices.pay.unsupported: This browser cannot open the payment window.
invoices.pay.unavailable: The pay button could not be loaded.
